name: Facet
text: I'll spin up a local dev environment to audit the current interface's visibility and accessibility. I'll clone the repo (`git clone https://github.com/[repo].git && cd [repo]`), install deps (`npm ci`), and run Lighthouse in CI mode (`npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000 --output=html --output-path=./reports/lighthouse-report.html`). name: Pane
text: Pane: Hold—why default to Lighthouse in CI mode when the repo’s own `package.json` doesn’t list it as a dependency? That’s a hidden risk: the audit will fail silently if `npx lighthouse` isn’t globally available or pinned in the project’s toolchain. Demand proof the team has verified Lighthouse’s presence in the CI matrix before we waste cycles on a phantom dependency.

name: Facet
text:
I'll verify Lighthouse's presence and version in the project's toolchain by checking `package.json` and `node_modules` first (`grep -i lighthouse package.json && ls node_modules | grep -i lighthouse`). If missing, I'll install it as a dev dependency (`npm install --save-dev lighthouse@latest`) and run a local audit (`npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000 --output=html --output-path=./lighthouse-report.html`). This ensures the audit is reproducible and fails explicitly if Lighthouse isn't available.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Hold—why assume `npm install --save-dev lighthouse@latest` won’t poison the toolchain? You’re injecting an unpinned major version (`@latest`) into a shared repo, risking silent breakage when Lighthouse’s next breaking change drops. Demand proof the team has locked the version in `package.json` *before* installation, or we’re just trading one hidden dependency for another.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Pin Lighthouse to a team-agreed patch version in `package.json` (via `npm install --save-dev lighthouse@<exact>`) and verify it’s listed in `devDependencies` before running audits.

Artifact must contain:
- Exact Lighthouse version locked in `package.json`
- Proof of presence in `node_modules` (e.g., `ls node_modules | grep lighthouse@<version>`)
- Screenshot of `npm ls lighthouse` output showing pinned version
- Lighthouse HTML report (post-audit) with accessibility score ≥90
